name: 法律文书印花税计算器

map.按《印花税法》计算常见法律文书/合同印花税: Computes stamp duty on common legal documents and contracts under the Stamp Duty Law
map.📖 查看「法律文书印花税计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Stamp Duty on Legal Documents User Guide"
map.产权转移书据: Document of transfer of property rights
map.小规模纳税人（减半）: Small-scale taxpayer, at half the rate
map.金额未列明的，按实际结算金额或按件贴花5元: Where no amount is stated, use the actual settled amount or pay ¥5 per document
map.📋 印花税税目税率表（2022年7月1日起）: 📋 Stamp Duty Items and Rates, from 2022-07-01
map.价款/报酬/使用费万分之三: 0.03% of the price, remuneration or royalty
map.仓储/保管费千分之一: 0.1% of the warehousing or storage fee
map.实收资本+资本公积合计万分之二点五: 0.025% of paid-in capital plus the capital reserve
map.📚 深度解析：法律文书印花税计算器: 📚 In-depth: Stamp Duty on Legal Documents
map.签订应税合同（借款、买卖、租赁等）前，按计税金额与税率估算: Before signing a taxable contract such as a loan, sale or lease, estimate the duty from the taxable amount and the rate
map.金额未列明的应税凭证暂按 5 元贴花。: A taxable document with no amount stated is stamped at ¥5 for the time being.
map.借款金额 100 万元，借款合同印花税税率 0.005%：100万 × 0.00: A loan of ¥1,000,000 at the 0.005% rate for loan contracts: 1,000,000 × 0.005% = ¥50, halved to ¥25 for a small-scale taxpayer.
map.购销金额 100 万元，税率 0.03%：100万 × 0.03% = 300: A purchase and sale amount of ¥1,000,000 at 0.03%: 1,000,000 × 0.03% = ¥300, halved to ¥150 for a small-scale taxpayer.
map.印花税应税凭证含借款合同、买卖合同、租赁合同、承揽合同、产权转移书据等；部分非应: Taxable documents include loan contracts, sale contracts, leases, work contracts and documents of transfer of property rights; some are not taxable, such as personal insurance contracts and interbank lending.
map.金额没写清怎么算？: What if the amount is not clear?
map.应税但金额未列明的，暂按 5 元贴花，结算后补贴；小规模纳税人等可享减征优惠。: A taxable document with no amount stated is stamped at ¥5 for the time being and made up after settlement; small-scale taxpayers and others may enjoy a reduction.
map.法律文书印花税计算器。法律合规工具，基于现行法律法规计算，数据本地处理。: Stamp Duty on Legal Documents. A legal compliance tool that computes under current laws and regulations, with all data processed locally.
